reasons.persona_fit: Speaks directly to the owner-operator in Bareni's calm, practical voice, adhering strictly to scope boundaries (declining sensitive legal/medical/financial work) and omitting sales CTAs.
reasons.clarity: Very easy to read, with an immediate central point, clear threshold test, and logical progression throughout.
reasons.actionability: Provides an immediately feasible diagnostic test and a three-point inventory next step while reinforcing mandatory human approval.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no unsubstantiated claims, respects Bareni's scope exclusions, and invents no customer data or unproven capabilities.
